_comment: Settings for monitoring/run.py and the scheduled GitHub Action (.github/workflows/monitoring.yml). Edit this file to change cadence, runs, variants, engines or budget; CLI flags on run.py still override it for a single manual run.

schedule._comment: frequency: off | daily | weekly | biweekly | monthly. off = no automatic runs, start them by hand (Actions -> Scheduled monitoring -> Run workflow, or the app's Run page). weekday is used by weekly/biweekly/monthly (monthly = first <weekday> of the month). The Action wakes daily ~06:00 Berlin time and exits immediately (no API calls) unless a run is due.

variants._comment: Per question, also ask N randomized rephrasings (zero-cost templates in monitoring/variants.py, different each run). Each variant is one extra call per engine.

gemini._comment: grounding=false: plain generation, works on the free tier (no citations). grounding=true needs a billed Google account (429 on free tier, tested 2026-11-19).

budget._comment: Hard caps per run. A run whose estimate exceeds either cap is aborted before any API call.
